# Code of conduct

Plainly follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short:

- Be respectful, patient and welcoming, whatever someone's experience, background or language.
- Criticise code and ideas, not people.
- No harassment, insults, or sexual or discriminatory content.
- Don't share anyone's private information.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer, [@paulherveph](https://github.com/paulherveph), through GitHub. Every report is read and kept confidential.

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close issues, or block anyone who breaks these rules.
